Terminology follows HoursCore/Export/ExportLanguage.swift wherever the two
overlap — the app and the timesheet it produces should not use two different
words for the same thing. Balance is Saldo (Solde in French), Expected is
Soll in German, Break is Pause.
Register is impersonal or imperative wherever that reads naturally, which
avoids choosing between du/Sie, tu/vous and ty/pan in nine languages at once.
Where a pronoun is unavoidable it is the informal one, except in French.

Closing a year fixes what it carried int: Ein Jahresabschluss legt fest, was ins nächste Jahr übertragen wurde; spätere Änderungen an diesem Jahr verschieben die Zahl nicht mehr. Clôturer une année fixe ce qu'elle a reporté sur la suivante ; les modifications ultérieures à cette année ne déplacent plus le chiffre. Fechar um ano fixa o que transitou para o seguinte, pelo que edições posteriores desse ano deixam de mover o valor. Um limite aplica-se às horas extra que lhe são devidas; um défice transita sempre por inteiro, porque perdoá-lo inventaria horas que ninguém trabalhou.
